Your healing spells are more effective.

Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional[1] equal to 2 + the spell's level.
<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_AuraOfVitality">Aura of Vitality</LSTag>'s <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_AuraOfVitality_Activate">Restore Vitality</LSTag> benefits from the additional[1].
